ARC100: Arcadian Platform Bed
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-arc100-arcadian-molded-platform-bed
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/arcadian-bed/
Spec sheets: ARC100 Arcadian Platform Bed, Arcadian Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Arcadian Molded Platform Bed – ARC100
Current H1: Norix Arcadian - Platform Patient Bed - One‑Piece Rotationally Molded Design - Model ARC100
Subtitle: One-Piece Ligature-Resistant Patient Bed with a Fluid-Containing Mattress Deck for Behavioral Health Facilities
Current subtitle: Norix ARC100 Arcadian Molded Bed for Behavioral Health Facilities
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Arcadian Platform Bed is a one-piece, rotationally molded bed for behavioral health patient rooms, with a residential look and the durability of high-impact polyethylene. The seamless design has no internal openings, pass-throughs, or tie-off points, which reduces ligature risk and leaves nowhere to hide contraband once the bed is bolted down.
Inverted internal support ribs give the bed its strength without interior foam and keep surface movement to a minimum. Raised outer edges contain fluids, and the gently crowned mattress deck drains them toward the corners, so the bed is easy to clean with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with no internal openings
Support: Inverted internal rib structure for strength and minimal surface movement, with no interior foam
Fluid Containment: Raised outer edges and a gently crowned top that drains fluids toward the corners
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Overall Size: 38”W×82”L×16.9”H
Mattress Deck: 36”W×80”L, for a 36”×80” mattress
Weight: 116 lbs
Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sage, Sand, Sienna, or Dove
Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,500 lbs
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletins 133, 117, and 116; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning; bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 can be used per the manufacturer’s instructions
Warranty: Lifetime warranty
Recyclable: 100% recyclable
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
ARC100 – Arcadian Platform Bed: 38”W×82”L×16.9”H, 116 lbs
Restraint Ring Kits: Optional removable restraint ring kits, individual (PRD-RR01K-01) or set of 6 (PRD-RR06K-01), with a 2.5”×0.75” ring opening
Installation and Options
Bolt-Down: Bolt-down kit required for floor anchoring. The Norix anchoring system uses concealed hardware and is intended for concrete floors and/or walls
Security Caulk: May be applied around the perimeter after anchoring
Inspection: Norix recommends checking the fasteners after each use of the restraints and every month; there should be no gap larger than 1/16” between the bed and the floor
Assembly: None required
[H2] Applications
The Norix Arcadian Platform Bed suits patient rooms where a bed has to be safe and easy to clean, and still feel like home.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers
Rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Arcadian Bedroom Furniture
The Norix Arcadian Series brings a residential look to behavioral health patient rooms, with furniture rotationally molded from a specially formulated, high-impact polyethylene that stands up to intensive use.
Common characteristics of Arcadian furniture include:
Ligature Resistant Design: One-piece, seamless construction eliminates pass-throughs and tie-offs
Concealed Hardware: Floor anchoring with concealed, tamper-resistant hardware
Contraband Resistant: No creases or nooks to hide contraband when bolted down
Infection Control: Seamless surfaces are impervious to fluids and can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants
Inverted Support Ribs: Internal ribs add strength without interior foam
Environmentally Responsible: Every piece is 100% recyclable
The Arcadian Series includes a platform bed, nightstand, floor-mount desk, open chest, two shelf units, and wardrobes with or without a molded door.
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
New series section: the six Arcadian products in this batch (ARC100, ARC800, ARC801, ARC700, ARC250, ARC600) share an "About Norix Arcadian Bedroom Furniture" section based on the Norix Arcadian brochure. It has no links to individual products. Please review it here; any changes will be applied to all the Arcadian tabs.
PRICE: the live page shows $0.00 with no compare-at price. The Norix April 2026 price list says $2,433. At your usual 80% of list, the price would be $1,946.40 (compare-at $2,433).
Warranty: our current page says "10 year limited warranty," but the current Norix spec sheet (September 2026) says "Lifetime warranty." I used the spec sheet.
Bolt-down kit: Norix says the bolt-down kit is required for floor anchoring, but the price list does not show a price for it. Is it included with the bed, or sold separately?
Restraint ring kits: our current page lists PRD-RR01K and PRD-RR06K; the Norix spec sheet gives PRD-RR01K-01 and PRD-RR06K-01 (list $202 and $1,212). They are not variants on our page. Do we sell them?
Flammability: the Norix spec sheet lists CAL TB133, TB117, TB116, ASTM E1537, and NFPA 261, so I included them.
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (row 180: 116 / 82 / 38 / 16.9).
Images: the 7 current images are kept (6 colors and a color chart, no alt text). Image 1 (Twilight) is 637×341. Norix also has a room photo with the bed, nightstand, shelf, and desk in Sage (2560×1440). Would you like me to add it as "Norix-Arcadian-Bedroom-Furniture-Sage-Room-View.jpg"?
Collections: the bed is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Norix Furniture.
Removed: the "advantages" list (now covered by the series section) and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph.
